definition: בִּכּוּרָה noun feminine first ripe fig, early fig (regarded as a delicacy) ( Löw 391 ; compare Arabic , Spanish albacora , Moorish bokkôre ) Mic 7:1 ; Hos 9:10 suffix בִּכּוּרָהּ = בִּכּוּרָתָהּ (read בִּכּוּרָה Di ), Isa 28:4 plural בַּכֻּרוֺת Jer 24:2 ** probably a different word, plural abstract = early ripeness , compare Du.
